meta.title: Submitting after un-awarding everyone is refused

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer sends the award proposal call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Proposal cannot be empty. Please award the vendors again.”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: Submitting after un-awarding everyone is refused

expected.message: Proposal cannot be empty. Please award the vendors again.
